---
title: "Lightbox: options"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 smoke-all/lightbox/options.qmd. The object form
# turns on automatic mode with `match: auto` and feeds the GLightbox
# constructor; option keys are emitted in Q1's stable order (#11124), with
# `css-class` becoming GLightbox's `skin`.
lightbox:
  match: auto
  effect: fade
  desc-position: top
  loop: true
  css-class: cool-beans
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'a.lightbox > img[src="images/mv-0.png"]'
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - "GLightbox\\(\\{\"selector\":\".lightbox\",\"closeEffect\":\"fade\",\"openEffect\":\"fade\",\"descPosition\":\"top\",\"loop\":true,\"skin\":\"cool-beans\"\\}\\)"
        - []
---
